faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: Two or three days is usually enough, though end-of-month dates fill up faster. If the move is urgent, write to us and we will see what can be shifted.

faq.q: Do I need to buy boxes and wrap?
faq.a: No, we bring the materials and include them in the estimate. If you already have boxes at home, we use yours.

office.title: Office, shop and commercial moves
office.lead: We work evenings, nights and weekends so the business keeps running. Equipment, documents and furniture travel with an inventory.
office.metaTitle: Office and shop moves in Lisbon — Car-Go!

faq.q: Can the move happen in one night?
faq.a: Usually yes: we measure the volume during the free estimate and put in as many people and vans as it takes for you to open as usual in the morning.
Yes. We agree the paperwork during the estimate — tell us what your accounting needs.

assembly.title: Furniture assembly and minor repairs
assembly.lead: We assemble a kitchen, wardrobe, bed or shelving unit — with the manual or without it. While we are there, we hang shelves and help with small fixes.

faq.q: Will you assemble furniture I bought myself?
faq.a: Of course. Tell us what the furniture is and how many pieces — we will work out the time.

faq.q: What if parts are missing from the box?
faq.a: We check the contents before starting. If something is missing, we help sort it with the shop and come back once the part arrives.

turnkey.title: Full-service move

faq.q: Do I need to be there during the move?
faq.a: Just open the door at the start and check at the end. The rest is on us, with one contact person available throughout.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a: The earlier the better, especially for weekends and the end of the month. The date is fixed during the free survey.

items.q: How much does a move cost?
items.a: There is no price list: every move is different. We do a free survey and tell you the price before we start.

items.q: What does the price depend on?
items.a: The volume of your belongings, the addresses and the distance between them, and the services you choose — packing, dismantling, assembly.

items.q: Do you dismantle and assemble furniture?
items.a: Yes. We take it apart at the old address and put it back together at the new one, wherever you want it.
Yes, with our own materials: boxes, stretch film, paper and blankets. Everything, or just the fragile part.

items.q: How many people can you send?
items.a: We size the crew to the job: more movers and more than one van when the volume calls for it.
Yes, across Portugal. Outside the Lisbon area the terms are agreed during the survey.

items.q: Do you move heavy or fragile items?
items.a: Yes. We have experience with large and delicate pieces and bring dollies, straps and blankets to move them.

items.q: Do you work on weekends and public holidays?
items.a: Yes, weekends and public holidays included. The price does not change: the day of the week makes no difference.
